references.text: The people of Israel did what was evil in the Lord's sight and worshiped the Baals. They abandoned the Lord and served Baal and the images of Ashtoreth.
When the judge died, they turned back and acted worse than their fathers. They followed other gods and served them.
The people of Israel did what was evil in the Lord's sight and forgot the Lord their God, and they worshiped the Baals and the Asherah poles.
The temple of Baal-Berith is mentioned as the place where Abimelech received silver to hire men.
The temple of El-Berith is mentioned, which is the same as Baal-Berit, the house of the covenant god.
The warning against making a covenant with the inhabitants of Canaan and engaging in spiritual adultery after their gods, the Baals.
Moses' prophecy that the people would engage in spiritual adultery with foreign gods after his death.
The prophet Hosea accuses Israel of having forgotten the Lord and followed the Baals.
